evals.prompt: 衡迹里最近 30 次体重是多少，整体趋势如何？
evals.expected_output: Queries live weight_record objects read-only, converts measuredAt correctly, reports units/range and avoids medical diagnosis.

evals.prompt: 本周记录了哪些饮食和运动，热量收支如何？
evals.expected_output: Queries live meal_record and workout_record data, reports meal-day coverage, does not treat missing meals as zero intake, and distinguishes estimates from measured weight change.
